name: subdomain_enum
description: Discover subdomains of a domain via Certificate Transparency logs (crt.sh), DNS brute forcing a common wordlist, search engine results, or all of the above combined.

action.description: crt_sh: Certificate Transparency logs (fast, passive). dns_brute: brute-force common subdomain names via DNS. search_engines: scrape search results. all: run crt_sh and dns_brute together and combine results (most thorough, slowest).

domain.description: The domain to enumerate subdomains for (e.g. 'example.com').

wordlist_size.description: Wordlist size for action='dns_brute'. Defaults to 'small'.
